steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing time with Maria!

Would you like help turning that into an email or draft to share with someone? Here are a couple of quick templates you can use — tell me which one you prefer and who to send it to (or I can save it as a draft):

Suggested subject lines:
- Quick: "Weekend away in the countryside"
- More personal: "Fresh air and nature trails — weekend with Maria"

Short (casual) version:
Hi [Name],
Just got back from a relaxing weekend in the countryside with my sister, Maria. We explored some nature trails and enjoyed the fresh air — it was exactly what we needed. Hope you’re doing well!
Best,
[Your name]

Longer (detailed) version:
Hi [Name],
I wanted to share a quick update — I spent the weekend in the countryside with my sister, Maria. We hiked a few lovely nature trails, spent time outdoors breathing fresh air, and just relaxed away from the city noise. It was a peaceful break and we came back feeling recharged. I’ll send some photos if you’d like to see them.
Take care,
[Your name]

What would you like me to do with one of these? Options:
- Send it now (tell me recipient email)
- Save as a draft
- Edit the message or add photos
- Something else (reply to a specific email about the trip)

Tell me which option and any details (recipient, tone changes, photos to attach).
